title: Bug: the installer trusts a PATH directory unless other users can write to it
objective: In install.sh, add the directories on PATH that hold npx or docker to permissions.exec_path of the user config so that rea serve can find them. Skip a directory inside the install tree or the temporary directory, and skip one that other users can write to, printing a line for each skipped directory. An existing exec_path list is kept without duplicates.
